description: For finite symbol sets \(S,T\), models \(M,N\) of theories \(T_1,T_2\), an isomorphism \(e\) of their common reducts, and a chosen \(m_0\in M\), the specified structure obtained by keeping the first interpretations, transporting private second-side interpretations along \(e\), and using \(m_0\) for unused functions satisfies both translated theories on the domain \(M\).
